rationale: CORRECTED sign conventions: shoulderFwd + = behind, - = forward; leftShoulder/rightShoulder rotZ - = raise arm up. To achieve "drape both forearms over backrest" (which is a prop at chest/shoulder height, not rendered): (1) raise both arms via negative shoulder abduction (-25) to bring elbows UP to ~y=0.5 (geometry: elbow.y = shoulder.y - upper_arm_length*cos(abduction); abduction=65° → elbow.y ≈ 0.68-0.18=0.50); (2) shoulderFwd symmetric -15 (forward, both arms reach toward imaginary backrest in front-side); (3) elbow flexion 70→90 (forearm horizontal, draping). globalTwist=25 (NEW) rotates whole body 25° left — produces the "torso toward camera" rotation required by description (rig cannot independently rotate upper vs lower body, so globalTwist is the only mechanism). RIG LIMITATION: no axial rotation joint for upper body — globalTwist rotates legs too, but legs are in seated position (less visually affected than torso). Sweep missed these defects — claim-detection regex does not cover "rotate torso" or "drape over backrest" patterns. Shoulders made symmetric (-25 both) for matching arm posture.
